newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan AEM power utility names sale advisors.
newsitem.headline: Milan AEM power utility names sale advisors.

text.p: Milan city council has named Italian merchant bank Sopaf and British investment bank BZW as joint advisers for a planned flotation of 49 percent of the capital of municipal gas and electricity utility AEM.
Milan city budget councillor Paolo Vantellini, in charge of the utility's privatisation, told reporters that AEM would be seeking a bourse listing in about four to five months.
"We are going forward with the sell-off," he said, despite some opposition to the float of the municipal company.
A regional administrative court recently decided to allow a referendum on the privatisation. "But we will go to court and are sure we will get this decision overturned," Vantellini said.
